content: Wikipedia Snowflake ID: 64 bits = 1 unused sign bit + 41-bit ms timestamp since custom epoch + 10-bit machine id + 12-bit per-ms sequence. Only 63 bits variable so value stays non-negative in signed 64-bit; 41 bits of ms ~= 69 years lifetime from epoch. Twitter epoch 1288834974657; Discord 1420070400000; Instagram uses 41/13/10 with shard id; Mastodon uses 48-bit ms from Unix epoch + 16-bit sequence. Serialization generally textual decimal.
